text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% with another hike signaled while payrolls badly missed at just 29,000 jobs — this combination of tightening into a weakening labor market raises recession risk, so consider holding extra cash and being very selective with new positions.
IONQ is down nearly 13% and 47% off its high with negative earnings and 10% short interest — reduce this speculative quantum computing position before it deteriorates further like RGTI and QBTS.
MSTR is 54% off its high with deeply negative free cash flow and acts as a leveraged Bitcoin bet — trim while you still have an 8.5% gain rather than risk giving it all back in a tightening cycle.
GOOGL trades at a reasonable PE of 23 with 15% revenue growth, strong free cash flow, and insider buying — this is one of your strongest fundamental holdings and worth adding to on any pullback.
UNH at a PE of 16.6 with nearly 12% revenue growth and a 4.8% free cash flow yield is a defensive, high-quality name that makes sense to build into given the weakening economic backdrop.
